purpose: Interior design as measured planning of rooms for actual occupants, tasks, access, light, acoustics, materials, cost, and maintenance.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name room, occupants, jurisdiction, and date. Do not infer usability from photographs or claim code compliance without the applicable rule and qualified review.
